annotations.title: Cost of living in a city for a family of 2+1

description: Use for how much it costs per month to live in a Polish city (family of 2+1, renting or owning) and to compare cities for a move. Give the period of each component; living expenses are a Poland average. Koszt życia w mieście finwire (finwire_city_cost_of_living): monthly cost of housing and living of a family of 2 adults and 1 child in 17 Polish cities, renting a 3-room flat (median asking rent) or owning it without a mortgage, ranked from the cheapest. Components with periods: rent, owners association fee, central heating, water, waste and electricity (GUS rates), property tax at the upper limit, living expenses outside housing (GUS household budget survey, Poland average, indexed with CPI), flat price per m2 (RCN deeds) and years of rent to buy. For rents only use get_rents, for running costs only get_housing_costs.

city.description: City name or slug (e.g. "Kraków" or "krakow") to get one city with the full breakdown; omit for all cities.
